paper_metadata.title: Effect of the c' volume fraction on the creep strength of Ni-base superalloys

evidence.quote: Three single-crystalline Ni-base superalloys with varying content of the c0 phase are investigated with respect to their microstructure and creep behaviour at 1000 °C.
Single-crystal specimens oriented in [001] direction were used for creep testing of alloys W11SX, W21SX and W31SX.

Single-crystal bars of the selected alloys were manufactured at Doncasters, Bochum, in the form of 20 mm diameter rods, 120 mm long.
For the alloy with the highest c0 volume fraction (W11), a three-step solution heat treatment (1250 °C/1 h + 1270 °C/1 h + 1290 °C/3 h/argon quench) was necessary
All alloys were subsequently aged at 1100 °C/4 h/air cool + 850 °C/24 h/air cool.
